items.title: Louis Gallaud Interview, 1960-03-18
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Joe Avery used to play. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, he did too.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. We lived there one time.
I don't remember that club. There was one hall there where the Buzzards have, they used to have dances where Joe Avery used to play.
